message: I've had moments when my phone decided to give up on me right when I needed it most. It’s a little reminder that it’s wise to have a plan in place for those unexpected times. I came across some really helpful tips on how to prepare an emergency kit, which can be a lifesaver when technology lets us down. Having some essentials ready can give us peace of mind and keep our families safe. It’s always better to be prepared and have what you need on hand. Have you thought about what you’d include in your own kit?
